Top Anwar Masood Funny Poems | Jashn-e-Rekhta Mushaira Full Recitation
One of Pakistan’s most prominent poets of humour and satire, Anwar Masood presents a selection of his best-known, funniest poems at the Jashn-e-Rekhta 2016 mushaira in Delhi. With his sharp observation and effortless wit, he turns everyday life, social habits, and human contradictions into poetry that feels immediate and familiar. This full recitation captures the range of his humour, from light, conversational lines to deeper satire that lands with a sting after the laughter.
